author: Animalogic
description:
Triceratops has come a long way. From being thought to be a potential mammal they’re now one of the world’s most popular dinos. So we’re going through the history of our idea of triceratops and the discoveries that shaped those ideas, including my own discovery of a triceratops fossil. 

00:00 The Evolution of Triceratops
00:32 1887–1889: From "Bison Alticornis" to Triceratops horridus
03:27 1891–1896: Marsh's First Skeletal Reconstructions
04:35 1901: Charles R. Knight’s Historic Art and Models
06:45 1905: "Hatcher" and the Sprawling Lizard Posture
08:12 The 2019 Remount: T-Rex vs. Triceratops
08:50 1918–1933: Early Cinema (Ghost of Slumber Mountain & Lost King Kong Scene)
12:32 1940: Disney's Fantasia & Prehistoric Climate Shifts
13:52 1947: Rudolph Zallinger’s The Age of Reptiles
15:08 1966: One Million Years B.C.
15:46 1980s: The Dinosaur Renaissance & The Land Before Time
17:16 1993–1999: Jurassic Park to BBC's Walking with Dinosaurs
19:17 2000s: Skin Impressions, Ontogeny, and t
title: How Did Triceratops Go From This To That?
